summary: MongoDB filed an 8-K reporting a September 25, 2026 board authorization of an additional $1.0 billion for its existing share repurchase program, lifting aggregate authorization to $2.0 billion, with $1,353,700,000 remaining available as of the September 29, 2026 filing date. Repurchases may occur via open-market or privately negotiated transactions at management's discretion, subject to market conditions, and may be suspended or terminated at any time. The filing also furnished an Investor Day presentation under Regulation FD; no price, premium, or expiration terms were stated. Watch buyback execution pace and any Rule 10b5-1 plan adoption.
